CHARGING CONNECTIONS
====================

DC8020 Connector
----------------

Compatible with Jackery portable power stations with DC8020 input port(s).

.. image:: asset:web/js40c/eu/en/charging-dc8020
   :alt: SolarSaga 40 Air connected to a Jackery portable power station through a DC8020 connector.
   :width: 100%

DC8020–DC7909 Adapter
---------------------

Compatible with Jackery portable power stations with DC7909 input port(s).

.. image:: asset:web/js40c/eu/en/charging-dc7909
   :alt: SolarSaga 40 Air connected through the DC8020 to DC7909 adapter.
   :width: 100%

DC8020 to USB-C Adapter Cable
-----------------------------

Compatible with Jackery portable power stations with USB-C input port(s).

.. image:: asset:web/js40c/eu/en/charging-usb-c
   :alt: SolarSaga 40 Air connected through the DC8020 to USB-C adapter cable.
   :width: 100%

.. note::

   The DC8020 to USB-C Adapter Cable is used to charge Jackery portable power station only. Do not use it to charge any other devices.
